purpose: Dual-reference qualification and recovery-score consequences on new external designs; numerical consensus is not proof of exact support or uniqueness
delta_comparison: strict greater-than using exact Fraction F1 values and Fraction(str(delta))
wall_budget_scope: Combined recorded invocations under this frozen configuration; checked between targets, not a hard interruption of a library fit
source_scope: News is row-sampled from one fixed seed-0 training design; gene keeps all 72 rows, with independent support/sign/noise conditional on one fixed design. Sources are not difficulty matched or a random dataset sample.
grouping_scope: No grouping or dense p-by-p Gram is computed in this runner. Any X-only group analysis is separate and retains original-variable scores.
